belay.1: Stand on the third ledge, reached by the short chimney above the second large ledge.
belay.2: Stand on a ledge with bolts at the top of the double crack pitch.
belay.3: Stand on a good ledge at the top of the crux offwidth pitch.
belay.4: Stand on a large ledge at a bolted anchor, at the top of the face pitch.

belay.P1: Stand at the end of the roof where the triple crack system finishes.
belay.P2: Stand on the big sandy ledge at the top of the layback corner.
belay.P3: Stand on a large ledge above the twin handcrack.

belay.2: Stand on the crest at the top of the featured face.
belay.5: Stand at an exposed stance just up and right of where the dihedral ends.

belay.P1: Stand below the treed ledge, after the corner slabs out and you continue straight up.
belay.P2: Stand on the second treed ledge above the tight, flaring corner.
belay.P3: Stand on a mossy ledge just right of the base of the left-facing dihedral.
belay.P4: Stand on the ledge with a large snag, at the top of the tips crack.
